verdicts.method: code reading of the self-test's own figure and standards checks
verdicts.evidence: thresholds.js:429-430 skip at count 0 and requirements() (thresholds.js:663-695) does not require a count: true. But the self-test, run by check:selftest and inside check:visual and judged check by check, requires placements: app.js:11350 'fig1?(fw.n===0&&fw.worst===0):(fw.n>0&&fw.worst<=0.02)' over 78 states (13 clocks x 2 presentations x 3 highlights) at each of 4x and 10.33x (figureError, app.js:9503-9523, uses the same kitGeos()), and app.js:12473-12474 requires nStd>0. A kitGeos/kitWrap regression or missing standards therefore fails both runs.

corrected.observed: The harness's per-case figure and standard measures are skipped at count 0 (a redundant second check); the named regression (kitGeos or kitWrap listing nothing, no standards) fails the self-test's 'figures: every visible man, horse and standard stands on the drawn ground' (n>0 required) and its standards count (nStd>0) in check:selftest and check:visual. Residual: a view-specific absence (one case drawing no figures) would not fail.

verdicts.evidence: animAt (app.js:1017-1020) is 'the hook's arithmetic in JavaScript'; the gait-on-ground, contact (runtime-test.js:1418-1448) and envelope (app.js:12846-12850 via animPoses) checks use it. The only GPU read of a pose, 8D's controlled deformation (app.js:12819-12846), checks only that the frame and the shadow change (dF2>0, dS>0), not where. No test evaluates animGLSL (grep: css-test.js:484, 587 are text pins). Indirect only: the cull equivalence would see a too-small envelope only at the frustum's edge.
verdicts.notes: animAt and animGLSL were introduced by 8D (4cb72b1) and extended by 8E: the gap is Stage 8's, not inherited.

verdicts.evidence: Re-run: css-test.js exit 0 under M08 (docs/audit-post8-evidence/verification/v-batch-tests/rerun.json). css-test.js:380 tests derivedTag() anywhere in marchRow; marchRow has 2 occurrences at HEAD (app.js:7926 readHidden path, 7929 visitor path) but 1 in archive/step5c-45f8f662.html: the second came with 8C's readHidden path (6fd80ea), so before Stage 8 this pin would have failed M08. 434 '.test(' occurrences confirmed; css-test.js also executes data and LABELS in vm (css-test.js:309-331, 909-912), so 'source text only' is mostly, not wholly, true. runtime-test.js D-6 caught M08 (recorded).

verdicts.method: re-run of M25 (audit.js, sim-test.js, check:chronology, redteam.js) + code reading of css-test.js and the manifest
verdicts.evidence: Re-run M25 (SPEED_CEIL.inf 6.0): audit.js 0 violations, sim-test.js 0 disagreements, chronology --check exit 0, redteam.js fails only on the acknowledged warning's text (1.35 to 1.36) (docs/audit-post8-evidence/verification/v-batch-tests/rerun.json); audit.js:45, sim-test.js:40, chronology.js:627 read SPEED_CEIL from the code: true. But SPEED_CEIL is a guarded model declaration (M25 failed check:data, run in CI checks.yml:37): the same mechanism as tests #1. ARROW_CAP's decided 16 px is pinned by css-test.js:391 in a block naming decision 241 (css-test.js:386-406), exactly the finding's own expectation, and by 3 manifest names carrying '16 px'.
verdicts.notes: The SPEED_CEIL half overlaps tests #1 (TS-2): a guarded model value held by check:data, which a data task moves; not a full duplicate (the browser half is distinct).

corrected.observed: For SPEED_CEIL the bound is read from the code by audit.js, sim-test.js and check:chronology, but the value is guarded by check:data as a model declaration (the tests #1 mechanism: only a data task can move it). For the browser constants the cited example, ARROW_CAP, is held by a source pin naming decision 241 and by the manifest's names; no decided constant without such a pin was shown.

verdicts.method: code reading of tools/step4/statements.js + the area's inventory-reach.json + data values
verdicts.evidence: statements.js:9-11 excludes 'names and identifiers ... enums and keys'; classes :15-40 match no tm.basis, PLANS.*.cols[n].n, staging[n].n or objectives[n].n; no test asserts completeness (grep). But tm.basis takes two values in data.js ('app narrative, unsourced' x19, 'source' x6): an enum of method apparatus, which the note's 'enums' covers in substance; the 12 cols[n].n are column names ('Advance Guard - Kienmayer'), the note's 'names', one or two carrying an interpretation ('The bait - Legrand, then Davout'). Clearly outside both: the 8 staging and 2 objective labels drawn on the map by planLabel (app.js:4521, 4536), e.g. 'Soult concealed in the Goldbach valley'.

corrected.observed: 10 plan labels drawn on the map (8 staging, 2 objectives) are narrative statements outside the inventory and its exclusion note; 12 column names are arguable (names, a few interpretive); the 19 timing bases are a two-valued enum the note's 'enums' plausibly covers. No completeness check exists: confirmed.
